annotations.title: Host a web page, publish HTML: a URL for your agent's output

description: Publish an HTML page and get a public URL for it (valid up to 7 days): send the HTML (up to 200,000 characters) and an optional title; the page is sanitised (no scripts, styles, frames, forms or event handlers; links and https images stay), screened by content moderation, stored, and served at /p/<id> with noindex. Use to hand a person a report, table or summary your agent produced, or to share results between agents. Removal requests: /support. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

days.description: Days the page stays online, 1 to 7 (default 7)

html.description: The HTML to publish (body content or a full document), up to 200,000 characters

title.description: Page title (default: the first line of text)

name: page_publish
